mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the past 3 months (negative change) signals positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined over the past 3 months (3-month change in FEDFUNDS < -0.5%).

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 300.0, it signals a high-inflation environment that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 40% of periods where CPIAUCSL > 300.0.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1.0% and the CPI (CPIAUCSL) is above 300.0, it signals a high-inflation, low-rate environment that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 40% of periods where FEDFUNDS < 1.0% and CPIAUCSL > 300.0.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 300.0), S&P 500 forward returns are negative over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of periods where CPIAUCSL > 300.0.

mechanism_narrative: The unemployment rate (UNRATE) level is always associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of periods where UNRATE is observed.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1700.0, it signals a weakening housing market that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 40% of periods where HOUST < 1700.0.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) is declining (INDPRO < 105.0) and GDP (GDPC1) is growing below 2.0% annualized (GDPC1 < 2.0% annualized), it signals a softening economy that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 40% of periods where INDPRO < 105.0 and GDPC1 < 2.0% annualized.

mechanism_narrative: In low unemployment regimes (UNRATE < 4.0%), S&P 500 forward returns are positive over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 40% of periods where UNRATE < 4.0%.
